text: 国家数据局消息，2026年9月1日至2日，国家数据局党组书记、局长刘烈宏一行赴内蒙古自治区调研，前往中国联通呼和浩特云数据中心、中国移动呼和浩特数据中心、华为云、优刻得、和林格尔集群多云算力资源监测与调度平台、中金数据乌兰察布零碳算力基地，以及内蒙古数据要素产业园、乳业国家技术创新中心、乌兰察布职业学院数字智能产业学院等，深入了解当地数据要素市场化配置改革工作推进情况。
text_en: According to the National Data Administration, from September 1-2, 2026, Liu Liehong, Secretary of the Party Leadership Group and Director of the National Data Administration, led a delegation to conduct research in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, visiting China Unicom Hohhot Cloud Data Center, China Mobile Hohhot Data Center, Huawei Cloud, UCloud, the Helingeer Cluster Multi-Cloud Computing Resource Monitoring and Dispatching Platform, China Finance Data Ulanqab Zero-Carbon Computing Base, as well as the Inner Mongolia Data Element Industrial Park, the National Technological Innovation Center for Dairy Industry, and the Digital Intelligent Industry College of Ulanqab Vocational College, to gain an in-depth understanding of the local progress in advancing reforms for market-based allocation of data elements.
